# Frankie & Fanucci's

> Frankie & Fanucci's offers authentic Neapolitan-style wood-fired pizzas, scratch-made with fresh ingredients. They also serve classic Italian appetizers, fresh salads, and pasta dishes.

## Menu
Specializing in authentic Neapolitan-style wood-fired pizzas, alongside classic Italian appetizers, fresh salads, and pasta dishes.
